parts.title: Tokenizer
parts.description: Build a tiny character-level tokenizer with vocab, stoi/itos, and encode/decode helpers.

parts.title: NumPy and Softmax Foundations
parts.description: Get fluent with NumPy arrays, indexing, broadcasting, reductions, and numerically stable softmax.

parts.title: Data Pipeline and Bigram Baseline
parts.description: Load the corpus, build batched (X, Y) sequences, and train a counting-based bigram model.

parts.title: Single-Layer Neural Bigram
parts.description: Replace the count table with a learned weight matrix; derive cross-entropy, gradients, SGD.

parts.title: Layer Primitives and Backprop
parts.description: Forward and backward for linear, bias, ReLU, softmax+CE, and LayerNorm building blocks.

parts.title: Embeddings and Self-Attention
parts.description: Token/positional embeddings, then masked single- and multi-head self-attention with backward.

parts.title: FFN, Blocks, and Full Model
parts.description: Feed-forward, residuals, pre-LN Transformer blocks, and the complete GPT forward/backward.

parts.title: Adam, Training Loop, and Generation
parts.description: Adam, the full training/validation loop, and sampling with temperature and top-k decoding.

steps.name: build_vocab
steps.doc: Return the sorted list of unique characters in ``text``.

steps.name: build_stoi
steps.doc: Map each character to its index: {char: i} for the vocab list.

steps.name: build_itos
steps.doc: Inverse map index -> character: {i: char} for the vocab list.

steps.name: encode_char
steps.doc: Encode a single character to its integer id.

steps.name: encode_string
steps.doc: Encode a string to a list of integer ids.

steps.name: decode_int
steps.doc: Decode a single integer id back to its character.

steps.name: decode_ids
steps.doc: Decode a sequence of integer ids back into a string.

steps.name: make_1d_array
steps.doc: Make a 1-D float array from a Python list of numbers.

steps.name: get_array_shape
steps.doc: Return the shape tuple of an array.

steps.name: get_array_dtype
steps.doc: Return the dtype of an array.

steps.name: make_2d_zeros
steps.doc: Return a (rows, cols) array of zeros.

steps.name: make_2d_random
steps.doc: Return a (rows, cols) array of standard-normal samples drawn from ``rng``.

steps.name: index_element
steps.doc: Return the scalar at row i, column j.

steps.name: slice_row
steps.doc: Return row i of a 2-D array.

steps.name: slice_column
steps.doc: Return column j of a 2-D array (as a 1-D array).

steps.name: slice_subblock
steps.doc: Return the sub-block a[r0:r1, c0:c1].

steps.name: elementwise_add
steps.doc: Element-wise sum of two same-shaped arrays.

steps.name: elementwise_multiply
steps.doc: Element-wise (Hadamard) product of two same-shaped arrays.

steps.name: scalar_broadcast_add
steps.doc: Add a scalar to every element (broadcasting).

steps.name: vector_matrix_broadcast_add
steps.doc: Add a length-``cols`` vector to each row of matrix ``m`` (broadcasting).

steps.name: array_exp
steps.doc: Element-wise exponential.

steps.name: array_log
steps.doc: Element-wise natural log.

steps.name: sum_all
steps.doc: Sum of every element (a scalar).

steps.name: sum_axis0
steps.doc: Sum down columns (over axis 0) -> shape (cols,).

steps.name: sum_axis1
steps.doc: Sum across rows (over axis 1) -> shape (rows,).

steps.name: max_along_axis
steps.doc: Maximum over the given axis.

steps.name: matmul
steps.doc: Matrix product a @ b.

steps.name: transpose_matrix
steps.doc: Transpose of a 2-D array.

steps.name: sum_keepdims
steps.doc: Sum over ``axis`` while keeping that dimension (size 1) for broadcasting.

steps.name: naive_softmax_1d
steps.doc: Softmax of a 1-D vector, the textbook (overflow-prone) way: exp / sum(exp).

steps.name: softmax_overflow_demo
steps.doc:
Show why naive softmax overflows: run it on large logits and return the
(nan/inf-polluted) result so the test can confirm the failure mode.

steps.name: stable_softmax_1d
steps.doc: Numerically stable softmax: subtract the max before exponentiating.

steps.name: stable_softmax_2d_rowwise
steps.doc: Row-wise stable softmax of a 2-D array: each row sums to 1.

steps.name: read_text_file
steps.doc:
Return the corpus text. Here the corpus is passed in directly as a string,
so this is effectively identity (real datasets would read from ``path``).

steps.name: encode_corpus_to_int_array
steps.doc: Encode the whole corpus into a 1-D int array of token ids.

steps.name: pick_split_point
steps.doc: Index that splits ``n`` tokens into a ``frac`` train / rest val.

steps.name: slice_train_and_val
steps.doc: Split the token array into (train, val) at ``split_idx``.

steps.name: pick_block_size
steps.doc: The context length (block size). Passed through here.

steps.name: slice_x_at_offset
steps.doc: Input window: tokens [i, i+block_size).

steps.name: slice_y_at_offset
steps.doc: Target window: the inputs shifted by one, tokens [i+1, i+block_size+1).

steps.name: sample_random_batch_offsets
steps.doc: Sample ``batch_size`` random start offsets so each window fits in ``n``.

steps.name: stack_x_batch
steps.doc: Stack input windows for each offset into a (batch, block) array.

steps.name: stack_y_batch
steps.doc: Stack target windows (shifted by one) into a (batch, block) array.

steps.name: get_batch
steps.doc: Sample a random (X, Y) batch of (batch_size, block_size) token windows.

steps.name: allocate_count_matrix
steps.doc: A (vocab, vocab) matrix of zeros to tally bigram counts into.

steps.name: loop_fill_counts
steps.doc: Tally bigram (current -> next) counts with an explicit Python loop.

steps.name: vectorize_counts_add_at
steps.doc: Same tally, vectorized with np.add.at over all adjacent pairs.

steps.name: add_one_smoothing
steps.doc: Laplace smoothing: add 1 to every count so no bigram has zero probability.

steps.name: row_sums_of_counts
steps.doc: Per-row totals, kept 2-D (vocab, 1) for broadcasting.

steps.name: normalize_counts_to_probs
steps.doc: Normalize each row of counts into a probability distribution.

steps.name: sample_next_token
steps.doc: Sample one token id from a probability row.

steps.name: generate_sequence
steps.doc: Generate ``n`` tokens from the bigram table, starting at ``start_token``.

steps.name: decode_generated_sequence
steps.doc: Decode generated ids back to text.

steps.name: log_prob_of_pair
steps.doc: Log probability the model assigns to the bigram (a -> b).

steps.name: sum_negative_log_probs
steps.doc: Total negative log-likelihood of every adjacent pair in ``data``.

steps.name: average_nll
steps.doc: Mean negative log-likelihood per bigram (the bigram model's loss).

steps.name: initialize_w_random
steps.doc: Random (vocab, vocab) weight matrix — the learned bigram 'table'.

steps.name: scale_w_small
steps.doc: Scale the weights down so initial logits are small.

steps.name: one_hot_encode_batch
steps.doc: One-hot encode a batch of token ids (B,) into (B, vocab_size).

steps.name: forward_logits_onehot
steps.doc: Logits as a matmul of one-hot inputs with the weights: (B,V) @ (V,V).

steps.name: observe_lookup_equivalence
steps.doc: One-hot @ W equals a plain row lookup W[x]; return True to confirm.

steps.name: forward_logits_lookup
steps.doc: Logits via row lookup W[x] — same result as one-hot @ W, far cheaper.

steps.name: logits_to_probs_rowwise
steps.doc: Row-wise softmax turning logits into next-token probabilities.

steps.name: gather_correct_token_probs
steps.doc: Pick out the probability assigned to each true next token y. Shape (B,).

steps.name: cross_entropy_loss
steps.doc: Mean negative log-prob of the correct tokens.

steps.name: derive_dlogits_on_paper
steps.doc: Gradient of softmax+cross-entropy w.r.t. the logits: (probs - onehot)/N.

steps.name: compute_dlogits
steps.doc: Implement dL/dlogits = (probs - onehot(y)) / N.

steps.name: derive_dw_on_paper
steps.doc: Gradient w.r.t. W. Since logits = W[x], dW = onehot(x).T @ dlogits.

steps.name: compute_dw_scatter_add
steps.doc: Same dW, computed by scattering each row's dlogits into row W[x[b]].

steps.name: sgd_update_w
steps.doc: One SGD step: W <- W - lr * dW.

steps.name: run_one_training_step
steps.doc: Forward, loss, backward, and SGD update for one batch. Returns (W, loss).

steps.name: train_neural_bigram_loop
steps.signature: train_neural_bigram_loop(w, data, n_steps, batch_size, lr, rng)
steps.doc: Train the neural bigram for ``n_steps`` SGD steps. Returns (W, losses).

steps.name: sample_from_neural_bigram
steps.doc: Generate ``n`` tokens by softmaxing each row W[cur] and sampling.

steps.name: linear_forward
steps.doc: Linear layer without bias: y = x @ W.

steps.name: derive_dx_on_paper
steps.doc: For y = x @ W, the input gradient is dL/dx = dout @ W.T.

steps.name: derive_linear_dw_on_paper
steps.doc: For y = x @ W, the weight gradient is dL/dW = x.T @ dout.

steps.name: linear_backward_dx
steps.doc: Input gradient of a linear layer: dout @ W.T.

steps.name: linear_backward_dw
steps.doc: Weight gradient of a linear layer: x.T @ dout.

steps.name: bias_add_forward
steps.doc: Add a per-feature bias, broadcasting over the batch: y = x + b.

steps.name: bias_add_backward_db
steps.doc: Bias gradient is dout summed over the batch (axis 0).

steps.name: relu_forward
steps.doc: ReLU: max(x, 0).

steps.name: relu_backward
steps.doc: ReLU gradient: pass dout through only where the input was positive.

steps.name: softmax_cross_entropy_backward
steps.doc: dL/dlogits for mean softmax+cross-entropy over a batch: (probs - onehot)/N.

steps.name: layernorm_forward_mean
steps.doc: Per-row mean over the feature axis, kept 2-D for broadcasting.

steps.name: layernorm_forward_variance
steps.doc: Per-row (population) variance over the feature axis, kept for broadcasting.

steps.name: layernorm_forward_normalize
steps.doc: Center and scale to unit variance: (x - mean) / sqrt(var + eps).

steps.name: layernorm_forward_affine
steps.doc: Learnable scale and shift: gamma * xhat + beta.

steps.name: layernorm_backward_subtract_mean
steps.doc: Backward through centering c = x - mean(x): dx = g - mean(g) over features.

steps.name: layernorm_backward_divide_std
steps.doc: Backward through dividing by a (constant) std: dc = g / std.

steps.name: layernorm_backward_full
steps.doc: Full input gradient dx of LayerNorm(x) * gamma, over the feature axis.

steps.name: layernorm_backward_implementation
steps.doc: Complete LayerNorm backward: returns (dx, dgamma, dbeta).

steps.name: create_token_embedding
steps.doc: Token embedding table (vocab, d_model), small random init.

steps.name: token_embedding_forward
steps.doc: Look up embeddings for token ids x (B,T) -> (B, T, d_model).

steps.name: token_embedding_backward
steps.doc: Gradient w.r.t. the table: scatter-add dout into the rows that were used.

steps.name: create_positional_embedding
steps.doc: Positional embedding table (block_size, d_model), small random init.

steps.name: slice_positional_embedding
steps.doc: Take the first ``t`` positions: (t, d_model).

steps.name: add_token_and_positional_embeddings
steps.doc: Sum token (B,T,d) and positional (T,d) embeddings (pos broadcasts over batch).

steps.name: embedding_sum_backward
steps.doc: Backward of tok+pos: (dtok, dpos). dtok = dout; dpos sums over the batch.

steps.name: create_qkv_projections
steps.doc: Single-head Q/K/V projection matrices, each (d_model, d_model).

steps.name: compute_query
steps.doc: Query projection: Q = x @ Wq.

steps.name: compute_key
steps.doc: Key projection: K = x @ Wk.

steps.name: compute_value
steps.doc: Value projection: V = x @ Wv.

steps.name: compute_attention_scores
steps.doc: Raw attention scores Q @ K.T -> (T, T).

steps.name: scale_attention_scores
steps.doc: Scale scores by 1/sqrt(d_head) to stabilize the softmax.

steps.name: build_causal_mask
steps.doc: Boolean (T,T) mask, True where a position must be hidden (strictly future).

steps.name: apply_causal_mask
steps.doc: Set masked (future) score entries to a large negative number.

steps.name: softmax_attention_weights
steps.doc: Row-wise softmax over the key axis -> attention weights.

steps.name: attention_weighted_values
steps.doc: Weighted sum of values: weights @ V.

steps.name: apply_output_projection
steps.doc: Project the attention output back to d_model: attn_out @ Wo.

steps.name: output_projection_backward
steps.doc: Backward of attn_out @ Wo: (d_attn_out, dWo).

steps.name: attention_value_backward
steps.doc: Backward of attn_out = weights @ V: (dweights, dV).

steps.name: masked_softmax_backward
steps.doc: Backward through the row-wise softmax: dscores from dweights and weights.

steps.name: scale_scores_backward
steps.doc: Backward of dividing scores by sqrt(d_head).

steps.name: qk_scores_backward
steps.doc: Backward of scores = Q @ K.T: (dQ, dK).

steps.name: qkv_projection_backward
steps.signature: qkv_projection_backward(dq, dk, dv, x, wq, wk, wv)
steps.doc: Backward of the Q/K/V projections: (dx, dWq, dWk, dWv).

steps.name: choose_attention_head_config
steps.doc: Per-head dimension d_head = d_model // n_heads (must divide evenly).

steps.name: create_multihead_qkv_projections
steps.doc: Combined Q/K/V projections for all heads, each (d_model, d_model).

steps.name: create_multihead_output_projection
steps.doc: Output projection Wo, (d_model, d_model).

steps.name: reshape_to_heads
steps.doc: Split the feature axis into heads: (B,T,d_model) -> (B,T,n_heads,d_head).

steps.name: transpose_heads_to_front
steps.doc: (B,T,H,d_head) -> (B,H,T,d_head) so each head is an independent (T,d_head) block.

steps.name: get_multihead_n_heads
steps.doc: Number of heads from a (B,H,T,d_head) tensor.

steps.name: get_multihead_sequence_length
steps.doc: Sequence length T from a (B,H,T,d_head) tensor.

steps.name: compute_d_head
steps.doc: Per-head dimension d_head from a (B,H,T,d_head) tensor.

steps.name: multihead_masked_softmax_scores
steps.doc: Per-head causal attention weights: softmax(QK^T/sqrt(d_head) + mask).

steps.name: multihead_weighted_sum
steps.doc: Per-head weighted sum of values: weights @ V -> (B,H,T,d_head).

steps.name: transpose_heads_to_back
steps.doc: (B,H,T,d_head) -> (B,T,H,d_head), ready to merge heads.

steps.name: get_multihead_output_sequence_length
steps.doc: Sequence length T from a (B,T,H,d_head) tensor.

steps.name: merge_heads_to_d_model
steps.doc: Concatenate heads back into d_model: (B,T,H,d_head) -> (B,T,d_model).

steps.name: multihead_output_projection_forward
steps.doc: Final output projection: (B,T,d_model) @ Wo.

steps.name: multihead_reshape_transpose_backward
steps.doc:
Inverse of reshape_to_heads + transpose_heads_to_front: take a per-head
gradient (B,H,T,d_head) back to (B,T,d_model).

steps.name: ffn_linear_one_forward
steps.doc: First FFN linear layer: x @ W1 + b1 -> (..., d_ff).

steps.name: ffn_activation_forward
steps.doc: FFN nonlinearity (ReLU).

steps.name: ffn_linear_two_forward
steps.doc: Second FFN linear layer: a @ W2 + b2 -> (..., d_model).

steps.name: ffn_backward
steps.signature: ffn_backward(dout, x, w1, b1, w2, b2)
steps.doc: Backward through the 2-layer ReLU FFN. Returns (dx, dW1, db1, dW2, db2).

steps.name: residual_forward
steps.doc: Residual connection: x + sublayer(x).

steps.name: residual_backward
steps.doc: Gradient splits equally to both branches of x + sublayer: (dx, dsublayer).

steps.name: pre_layernorm_sublayer_forward
steps.doc: Pre-LN sublayer: x + sublayer(LayerNorm(x)).

steps.name: transformer_block_forward
steps.doc: Pre-LN Transformer block: attention sublayer then FFN sublayer, each residual.

steps.name: transformer_block_backward
steps.doc:
Backward through a pre-LN Transformer block. Returns (dx, grads) where grads
mirrors the block dict (ln1, attn, ln2, ffn).

steps.name: stack_transformer_blocks
steps.doc: Create ``n_layers`` randomly-initialized pre-LN Transformer blocks.

steps.name: forward_through_all_blocks
steps.doc: Run the input through every Transformer block in order.

steps.name: backward_through_all_blocks
steps.doc: Backward through all blocks (reverse order). Returns (dx, [grads per block]).

steps.name: final_layernorm_forward
steps.doc: Final LayerNorm before the LM head.

steps.name: lm_head_linear_forward
steps.doc: Project hidden states to vocab logits: x @ W_lm + b_lm -> (..., vocab).

steps.name: full_model_forward
steps.doc: Full GPT forward: embeddings -> blocks -> final LN -> LM head. Returns logits.

steps.name: full_model_backward
steps.doc:
Full GPT backward from dlogits. Returns a grads dict mirroring ``params``
(tok_emb, pos_emb, blocks, ln_f, lm_head).
